local_policies: Preserve original full 179 Mage and 84 Arcane inventories with one weight per member. Shared generation rules filter the three main Quests and original source from the Mage request; they are never removed from the inventory.
NX2_001 uses its original fixed Mage query, two replacement random generated hand cards, each at minus two cost before delivery.

TIME_857 retains its original current-class Arcane query and two ordinary discoveries at minus two cost. Its former unresolved constructed.past.cards placeholder maps explicitly to its own complete runtime Arcane inventory; other old sources and pools remain unchanged.
The 11 playable class source scopes include genuine empty views. Class views are validated against the normal resolver rather than treated as final eligibility by themselves.
These are fixed local reference policies, not formal CN pool or hotfix certification. Exact unresolved past membership/reprint policies remain recorded in each unmodified reference.
